title: End-to-End ML Pipeline Trace & Root Cause Investigation

first_model_pass_zero_location.effect: records decision_hold; model_pass = buy_emitted + sell_emitted stays 0

summary: Research replay feeds real dataset_v2 features into predict_proba. Production runtime maps phase99_* merge columns (mostly zero on live bars) via row_for_phase99_range, drops ema_cross_state from the row, and often returns HOLD before predict_proba. When prob is computed on zeros, confidence falls below the 0.55 decision gate → decision_hold → model_pass=0.
